result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its data and IP; specifically created work product is assigned to Client; embedded TrueLink IP is subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence; and joint ownership is excluded. It preserves TrueLink’s existing ownership of the Interface and does not disturb its express licence to use Credit Data. The changes are targeted and professionally drafted, although “the same” could be defined more precisely and the phrase limiting embedded-IP use to the ordinary course of Client’s business adds a modest restriction.
